prompt: The test suite of this ledger project fails. Run it with `python -m unittest discover -s tests`, find the bugs in the ledger package that cause the failures, and fix them. Do not change any file under tests/. Run the test suite again at the end and make sure every test passes.

metadata.summary: Find and fix three bugs in different modules of a ~1,100-line package, guided by a failing test suite. Hidden check: tests unchanged and passing, bugs fixed when tested directly.
